description: This header file defines the SystemAudioPlayerImplementation class, which implements the ISystemAudioPlayer interface and handles audio playback functionalities, event handling, and configuration for an audio system. It includes class definitions, method declarations, macros, and external dependencies for the audio player component.

classes.name: SystemAudioPlayerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the ISystemAudioPlayer interface and managing audio player instances, events, and configurations.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Nested class used for dispatching audio events asynchronously within the SystemAudioPlayerImplementation context.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the audio player with given service parameters.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for event callbacks.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification sink.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens an audio stream for playback or processing.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback of an audio stream.

methods.name: PlayBuffer
methods.description: Plays audio data from a buffer.

methods.name: IsPlaying
methods.description: Checks if audio is currently playing.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures the system audio player with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetPlayerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the current player session ID.

methods.name: onSAPEvent
methods.description: Handles SAP events with specified message.
